label: WRONG
reason: Fire-and-forget wrapSocket emitters are named send* everywhere (chat/emits.ts, room/emits.ts, dice/emits.ts), but all five outliers are wrapSocketWithDataAck queries in assets/emits.ts that return a Promise of data and are named get*; across the repo 5 of 7 data-ack queries use get* and only notes/emits.ts sendGetNote and groups/emits.ts sendGetGroupInfo use sendGet*, so query getters are a recurring category a new get* query would be wrongly flagged for (0 of 5 counted mistakes). No naming rule exists in either .oxlintrc.json, so not TRIVIAL; hesitated with ACCEPT since the sendGet* precedent shows the send* scheme can cover queries.
